acceptance_criteria: A gesture is one-handed or two-handed by a stated rule, and an attempt is only compared with examples of the same kind
A second hand visible only briefly during a one-hand gesture, and a hand lost briefly during a two-hand gesture, are tolerated within stated limits
Resting before and after the movement is handled no worse than by the previous matcher; cutting rest away is left to a later card because every cut tried so far could speak a wrong concept
In every evaluation row and every reviewer probe, a known gesture spoken as the wrong concept and an unknown movement spoken as a concept are no more frequent than with commit 70bf62b
The synthetic evaluation covers one-hand, two-hand and mixed profiles, tracker jitter and one-frame jumps, and prints measured numbers; no threshold is lowered
A change that makes stored feature sequences incomparable raises FEATURE_SCHEMA_VERSION

goal: One-hand and two-hand gestures are told apart by rule and survive a second hand passing through and a hand lost for a moment, without ever speaking a wrong concept more often than the previous matcher.
